cases.name: Betty L. Weber
cases.about:
Her obituary said: "Betty graduated from Mayfield High School in 1985. She was a member of the Girls Rock Metal Detecting Club and the Civil War Preservation Project of Ohio (CWPPO). She participated in the Jesse Itzler challenges #wedohardstuff. She was passionate about her online fitness community, proudly achieving gold status for the last year. Betty was very active in the deaf community, especially in her church community, teaching others to sign and interpret for the hearing impaired. She was a marathon runner, who competed in several ultra-marathons. She organized the 100 inning softball game raising money for various charities for many years. She had an infectious smile and was very generous. She was always competitive and passionate for her Starbucks coffee. She loved the Lord and God’s creation and was a friend to everyone. The most important thing in Betty’s life was her family, especially her girls. She went by B-ma to Natalie, her granddaughter. She was a loving mother, grandmother, daughter, sister, aunt, cousin and friend. She lived an active life, touching many people and this is a great loss to her community."
